findings.location: Paragraph: "Some people may have poor coping skills." (around the paragraph discussing street drugs)
findings.source_quote: Some people may have poor coping skills. Unfortunately, many turn to street drugs or alcohol to try to smother the feelings that they can’t control otherwise.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the English term "street drugs" into contemporary Norwegian Bokmål. For example: "Dessverre tyr mange til gate- eller rusmidler (ulovlige rusmidler) eller alkohol for å forsøke å kvele følelser de ellers ikke klarer å kontrollere." Preserve the original sentence structure and HTML tags.
findings.translation_quote: Noen mennesker kan ha dårlige mestringsstrategier. Dessverre tyr mange til street drugs eller alkohol for å forsøke å kvele følelser de ellers ikke klarer å kontrollere.
